_about: Collision templates of the interactive objects (MOBJ types 196..335), extracted from g_mapEntityTemplates RF4S.exe+0x4D5030 by gen_exe_tables_json.py; index = max(0, type - 197), so type 196 uses 197's. Map_SpawnInteractiveObject RF4S.exe+0x143760 stamps a record's template when its f11 is 0 and it is shown: Map_StampEntityCollisionTiles +0x195FC0 ORs cell (c, r) into ATTR tile ((f14 + off_x) >> 3) - w / 2 + c, ((f15 + off_y) >> 3) - h / 2 + r, columns mirrored when f6 < 0; Map_TickEntityArray +0x143FB0 removes / re-stamps it when the object's flag hides / shows it. by_type: type -> template key (types without a template are left out). templates: key (the template's RVA) -> w, h (tiles), off (sub-units), z_bias (added to the object's depth), cells (w * h, row-major).
